title: Draft leagues shouldn't run on spreadsheets
series: AI x Pokémon (as on the original 44-draftpokemon; no episode number on the original)
hook: Draft leagues shouldn't run on spreadsheets
summary: Draft leagues shouldn't run on broken spreadsheets, so I built DraftPokémon.
body: Draft leagues shouldn't run on broken spreadsheets, so I built DraftPokémon.

Broken formulas, missed picks, arguments about whose turn it was. Every commissioner knows it.
DraftPokémon runs the draft in order, tracks every team and cuts the admin so you can actually play.
The best features came from commissioners replying to a plain email.

Try it for your next season: https://draftpokemon.com
Commissioners: try it and reply with what you would change.
